summary: Nov 2026 production hardening backend tests — ALL 20 PASSED (100%). Verified: (1) Pincode-scoped ShopLayoutBlock — POST /api/admin/shop-layout accepts scope_pincode, GET /api/shop-layout?pincode=500001 returns pincode-scoped + global(empty scope_pincode) blocks, GET with a non-matching pincode 999999 returns ONLY the global block, GET without pincode returns all. (2) GST bucket in Admin System Wallet — /api/admin/system-wallet response includes gst_bucket {total, invoice_count}; a POS sale with 18% GST (₹100 base) writes exactly one system_wallet_deposits doc with bucket='gst', source='gst_pos', amount=18.0, vendor_id, invoice_no, sale_id; re-fetched system-wallet gst_bucket.total increased by 18.0 and invoice_count incremented by 1. (3) Delivery-radius modes — GET /api/products?pincode=X correctly returns products where delivery_radius_mode ∈ {'both','pincode'} for matching store_pincode, EXCLUDES products with mode='radius' (no delivery_pincodes match) and mode='none', and INCLUDES a mode='radius' product when its delivery_pincodes explicitly lists the pin. Non-matching pincode returns none of the seeded test products. (4) All 8 named indexes present in Mongo: ix_prod_store_pin, ix_prod_del_pins, ix_prod_vendor on products; ix_ver_user_status, ix_ver_status_created on vendor_edit_requests; ix_sl_scope_active, ix_sl_scope_pin on shop_layout_blocks; ix_swd_bucket on system_wallet_deposits. Cleanup verified — no test artifacts remain in DB.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/shop_layout.py:213 — _scope_filter merges pincode-filter with scope-filter using $and only when scope-filter is non-empty. When scope='home' the $or covers legacy docs (no scope field / null / empty) and combines correctly with the pincode $or; verified via test 'test_get_without_pincode_returns_all'. No bug.

routes/vendor_pos.py:352-366 — GST deposit is wrapped in try/except that silently swallows write failures ('GST ledger is telemetry — never block the sale'). That's intentional per the comment, but consider logging the exception with logger.exception for observability. Not a blocker.

routes/products_public.py:132-149 — pincode filter treats delivery_radius_mode absent as pincode-mode (legacy default). Confirmed working. If a vendor sets mode='both' but does NOT populate store_pincode, the product will NOT appear — that's correct.

server.py:6786-6841 — All 8 new indexes are created inside startup try-block; if MongoDB is unreachable at startup, index creation is skipped silently. Consider surfacing this via /api/health so admins can monitor. Not required for this task.
